##### Project general facts

Emaar Properties presents Club Place, a premium residential development offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. The project combines contemporary sophistication with the refined elegance associated with Palace Hotels Resorts, surrounded by lush greenery.

Club Place features a wide range of amenities distributed across three distinctive buildings. Multiple swimming pools provide spaces for relaxation and recreation, while modern sports facilities support an active lifestyle. Sky terraces offer panoramic views and create comfortable spaces for socialising and enjoying the surroundings.

The residences feature modern finishes made with high-quality materials and equipped kitchens. Apartments are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their interiors according to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills Estate is a prestigious master-planned community in the heart of Dubai, developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas Holding. The area combines modern urban living with landscaped green spaces, creating a balanced residential environment.

The community is centred around an 18-hole championship golf course designed to international standards. The course adds greenery and a sense of tranquillity to the area while offering a distinctive setting for residents and golf enthusiasts.

Dubai Hills Estate is also a comprehensive lifestyle destination with a variety of retail, dining, leisure, health, and educational facilities. Dubai Hills Mall provides extensive shopping and entertainment options, while Central Park offers a spacious green area for relaxation and outdoor activities.
